description: This file implements socket handling classes for network communication, including socket creation, configuration, data transmission, server socket management, client socket connection, and socket multiplexing with select.

classes.name: Socket
classes.description: Represents a network socket with methods for configuration, data transfer, and management.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: Implements a server socket that listens for incoming connections on UNIX domain socket or TCP port.

classes.name: SocketClient
classes.description: Implements a client socket for connecting to UNIX domain socket or TCP server.

classes.name: SocketSelect
classes.description: Manages multiple sockets for multiplexed I/O using select().

methods.name: setWriteTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for socket write operations.

methods.name: setReadTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for socket read operations.

methods.name: isOpen
methods.description: Checks if the socket is open.

methods.name: getBytesReady
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes available to read.

methods.name: readBytes
methods.description: Reads bytes from the socket into a buffer.

methods.name: writeBytes
methods.description: Writes bytes from a buffer to the socket.

methods.name: acceptConnections
methods.description: Accepts incoming connection requests on a server socket.

methods.name: SocketClient (constructor)
methods.description: Creates a client socket connected to a UNIX domain socket or TCP server.

methods.name: SocketServer (constructor)
methods.description: Creates a server socket listening on UNIX domain socket or TCP port.
